items.name: Spec Compliance
items.note: sentinel, evidence refusal (refresh_compliance_docs, update_compliance), merge-base CI check, explicit key in project init and adopt, legacy-write guard, conditional gitignore re-include; no-op for legacy/absent without drops; CI workflow wiring left to the operator

items.name: Error Handling
items.note: refusals are typed and reported as unsupported_events_layout; CI check exits 2 on git trouble; ensure_layout_key cleans its temp file

items.name: Security Basics
items.note: raw config read ignores the test env override; check-ignore probes a file path; blobs via cat-file; no os.open modes

items.name: Test Quality
items.note: real git repos, synthetic merge commits, subprocess adopt writer, both refusal producers, rollback with leftover corrupt drop

items.name: Performance Basics
items.note: one config read and one folder listing per event write; gitignore probes only when drops adopted

items.name: Naming & Structure
items.note: new modules under 300 LOC; update_compliance kept at its baseline via a gate module

items.name: Affected Boundaries
items.note: producer (sync config key) to consumer (sentinel, CI check, adopt writer) probed with real files; reader of a legacy-appended log proven
